name: Paramount Skydance
description: Paramount Skydance owns the CBS network and stations, cable channels (Nickelodeon, MTV, BET, Comedy Central and others), the Paramount+ and Pluto TV streamers, and the Paramount Pictures and Skydance film and television studios. It makes money from advertising, affiliate and subscription fees (what cable and satellite operators and streaming subscribers pay), and licensing content to others. The business was formed when Skydance merged with Paramount Global (closed 2025-08-07). The big pending event is its agreed 2026-02-27 acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery at $31.00 per share (equity value $80.9B, plus assumption of WBD debt), funded with $46.7B from the Ellison family parties and delayed by a lawsuit; closing is postponed to the earlier of five days after a court ruling or 2027-06-01.

whatsNext.text: Acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery at $31.00 per share (equity value $80.9B at announcement, plus WBD net debt: $17.7B senior notes and $15.0B bridge borrowings at 2026-03-31); closing postponed because of a lawsuit until the earlier of five days after the court's ruling or 2027-06-01; ticking fee of $0.00277778 per WBD share per day after 2026-09-30 (up to $0.25 per 90 days); agreement termination date 2027-03-04, automatically extendable to 2027-06-04. Paramount paid a $2.8B termination fee to Netflix on WBD's behalf in Q1 2026 to end WBD's prior merger agreement; the Ellison Parties will fund $46.7B.
